k:獲.mnemonic: The hound (犭) dives into the flowers (艹) after a turkey (隹), and the hunter's hand also (又) closes on the bird. The catch is theirs. Get (seize, earn, acquire).
k:獲.hint: Hound and hand on the turkey.

k:到.mnemonic: The traveller, long gone (去) from home, reaches the climax (至) of his journey at the last gate and lays down his knife (刂) at the door. Arrival (proceed, reach, attain).
k:到.hint: Knife laid down at the last gate.

k:倒.mnemonic: The leader (亻) is toppled on the arrival (到) of the rebel army, and his statue is pulled to the ground the same afternoon. Overthrow (fall, collapse, break down).

k:背.mnemonic: For a month (月) the walkers head south, with the cold north (北) wind pushing between their shoulder blades the whole way. Back (stature, behind, disobey).
k:背.hint: North wind between the shoulder blades.

k:茶.mnemonic: A picker in a wide hat (𠆢) plucks the flowers (艹) and leaf tips from a small tree (木), dries them and steeps them in hot water. Tea.

k:救.mnemonic: After what feels like an eternity (永) trapped underground, the miners hear the strike (攵) of a pick breaking through the rock toward them. Salvation (save, help, rescue).
k:救.hint: A pick breaking through at last.

k:般.mnemonic: A boat (舟) with every weapon (殳) of the army stacked on its deck, ferrying the whole lot across the river in one trip. Carrier (carry, all, general).

k:整.mnemonic: In the middle (中) of the square, under the old tree (木), the town's politics (政) are sorted out: who speaks first, who sits where, everything put in order. Organize (arranging, tune).
k:整.hint: Sorting the town under the tree.

k:恐.mnemonic: The earthquake hits, the construction (工) overhead shakes, and you crouch under the table (几) with your heart (心) pounding. Fear (dread, awe).

k:詞.mnemonic: Everything you say (言) can (可) be sorted into labelled boxes: noun, verb, adjective. Each word goes into exactly one. Part of speech (words, poetry, language).

k:否.mnemonic: A mouth (口) that says only 'not (不)': whatever you propose, it shakes from side to side and turns you down. Negate (no, refuse, decline).
k:否.hint: The mouth that only says no.

k:織.mnemonic: The sound (音) of the loom: thread (糸) pulled tight, and the shuttle shot through it like a halberd (戈), back and forth all day. Weave (fabric).

k:功.mnemonic: Power (力) poured into construction (工), year after year, until the bridge finally stands across the river. Something to be proud of. Achievement (merits, success, honor).

k:照.mnemonic: Flames (灬) leap below and a shining (昭) glow spreads above: the bonfire lights up every face in the circle around it. Illuminate (shine, compare, bashful).

k:布.mnemonic: One (一) towel (巾) fresh from the loom, so smooth that your hand will slide (ノ) right across it without catching. Linen (cloth, spread, distribute).

k:街.mnemonic: People go (行) up one side and down the other, and between them is soil (土) packed two layers deep by all the feet and carts: the wide road through town. Boulevard (street, town, road).

k:探.mnemonic: In the dark wood your fingers (扌) feel ahead for the next tree (木) while your legs (儿) shuffle forward. Your forehead (冖) already found the last one. Grope (search, look for).
k:探.hint: Feeling for trees in the dark.

k:豊.mnemonic: On harvest day (日) the fields of Asia (亜) give so many beans (豆) that the baskets spill over and the carts cannot carry them all. Bountiful (excellent, rich).

k:遊.mnemonic: A child (子) sent down the path (辶) on an errand runs in every direction (方) except the one that leads back home. Play.

k:弁.mnemonic: A stopper shaped like a cocoon (厶) sits over the pipe, held down by twenty (廾) fingers, two full hands. Lift it and the steam rushes out. Valve (petal, speech, dialect).
k:弁.hint: Stopper held down on the pipe.

k:標.mnemonic: A ballot (票) nailed to a tree (木) at the crossroads, with an arrow drawn on it to show the way to the polling place. Signpost (mark, stamp, imprint).
k:標.hint: Arrow nailed up at the crossroads.

k:絵.mnemonic: Coloured threads (糸) meet (会) on the cloth, and where they cross a scene appears: mountains and a river, stitch by stitch. Picture (painting, drawing, sketch).
k:絵.hint: A scene appears in the stitching.

k:請.mnemonic: He will say (言) 'please' until he is blue (青) in the face, going from door to door asking for signatures. Solicit (invite, ask, inquiry).

k:飲.mnemonic: You eat (食) dry bread and at once feel the lack (欠) of something to wash it down. Your hand goes to the cup. Drink (smoke, take).

k:射.mnemonic: Somebody (身) takes a careful measurement (寸) of the distance to the target, draws the bow to his cheek and lets go. Shoot (archery, shine into).

k:訪.mnemonic: You set off in the direction (方) of a friend's house to say (言) hello in person, and knock at the door. Call on (visit, look up).

k:庭.mnemonic: The king (王) paces with a long stride (廴) under the canopy (广) that runs around the open square inside his palace, past the raked stones. Courtyard (garden, yard).

k:群.mnemonic: Mister (君) shepherd gives one whistle, and every sheep (羊) on the hill bunches up behind him in a single woolly mass. Flock (group, crowd, herd).
k:群.hint: One whistle and they bunch up.

k:秀.mnemonic: With one sweep of the scythe (乃) she cuts more grain (禾) than anyone else in the village manages in three. Nobody can match her. Excel (excellence, beauty, surpass).
k:秀.hint: The best scythe in the village.
